# Contribution Guide

This repository is Ably's fork of Laravel Echo. It publishes `@ably/laravel-echo` and, on the `2.x` branch, `@ably/laravel-echo-react`, `@ably/laravel-echo-vue` and `@ably/laravel-echo-svelte`.

- **Code changes:** see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) at the root of the repository for the prerequisites (Node.js and pnpm), the build, the checks to run before a pull request, and how this fork follows upstream `laravel/echo`.
- **Bugs and documentation issues:** open an [issue in this repository](https://github.com/ably-forks/laravel-echo/issues).
- **Questions and help using the library:** contact [Ably support](https://ably.com/support).
- **Problems on the Laravel server side:** see [ably/laravel-broadcaster](https://github.com/ably/laravel-broadcaster).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** don't open an issue; see the [security policy](SECURITY.md).

A change that is not specific to Ably, for example in the Pusher, Reverb or Socket.IO connectors, may belong upstream in [laravel/echo](https://github.com/laravel/echo), so that this fork can take it with the next re-sync.
